caseNameFull: WORTHINGTON CORP. v. MLODOZENIEC Et Al.
attorneys: Benedict T. Mangano for appellant., Louis J. Lefkowitz, Attorney General of New York, Paxton Blair, Solicitor General, and Roy Wiedersum and Gilbert M. Landy, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
